result.reason: The operative language satisfies every preferred requirement and therefore also satisfies the lower fallback limits. It is not minimal because it additionally requires all coverage to continue for one year after the agreement term and expressly places the expense on Licensor, neither of which was part of either stated position. Placement of the new insurance clause after the 'IN WITNESS WHEREOF' execution recital is structurally poor and creates avoidable uncertainty about whether the clause forms part of the operative agreement; the clause should appear before the execution recital. Subject to that drafting issue, the existing representation-by-counsel language remains unchanged and no direct contradiction is introduced.
